course_name_original: HISTORY OF TURKISH REVOLUTION AND ATATÜRK S PRINCI
course_name_en: HISTORY OF TURKISH REVOLUTION AND ATATÜRK S PRINCI

learning_outcomes.text: Gain the ability to think interdisciplinary by associating their own disciplines with the knowledge they learned in this course.
Gain the values such as unity, independence, national interests, nationality, active citizenship.
Develop a realistic perspective by associating a historical event with the events taking place today.
Learn to analyze documents while examining materials such as first-hand sources, documentaries, movies used during the course.
Have different perspectives on the subjects described in the course with the reading of auxiliary books on the course of Atatürk`s Principles and History of Turkish Revolution II.
Develop a sense of respect for different views and ideas, explore and read other views.
Gain experience on how to talk in front of the public while using discussion method in the group and in the course.

Learn to see their ancestors' difficulties and struggles, stand strong against the difficulties they have experienced in life, and adopt universal values while respecting them and their roots; Learn about their ancestors who became martyrs and veterans to protect their country, understand the value of the land of their homeland and gains the consciousness of national unity and solidarity.

syllabus_topics: National Struggle, Eastern Front and the Southern Front Collisions
Establishment of the Regular Army and the Western Front Collisions.
Orders of National Tasks (Tekalif-i Milliye Emirleri), Great Offensive, Mudanya Armistice.
The signing of the Lausanne Peace Treaty and the importance of this treaty.
Establishment of political parties. Democracy experiment in Republic of Turkey, revolts to democracy.
The reforms in educations and culture, health, and public works
The Reforms in economic and social life
The Republican Period of Turkey`s Foreign Policy: The solution of the problems that could not be solved in Lausanne between 1923-1932, foreign policy between 1932-1939.
Atatürk	s death and Ismet Inonu	s Period
Democrat Party Era and the general situation in the world and Turkey.
The developments in Turkey and in the world from 1980 to the present day.
